description.value: The spriggan has advantage on saving throws against being Frightened.
A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the Spriggan hits with it (included in the attack).
Thorne makes two attacks with its Living Trident.

The Spriggan adds 3 to its AC against one melee Attack that would hit it. To do so, the gladiator must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

The Spriggan knocks aside an incoming attack.

The Spriggan can grow weapons in their hands or a shields on their arms at will. These items function as per normal. This does not take an action, but they can only create one weapon and shield per turn.

Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.

Thorne attacks with a trident that grows directly from its gnarled arm.

(Requires attunement)

This armor consists of a fitted wooden chest piece and strange, supple leaves instead of leather. When worn it pulls tightly against the wearer, becoming almost like a second skin.

The armor naturally repairs itself of any damage it sustains, and also has the ability to mend its wearer. As a bonus action the attuned wearer can activate this armor, causing it to restore 2d10 hit points to them. The wearer must complete a long rest before they can use this feature again.

Wondrous Item (requires attunement)

This helmet appears to be made of pure wood and naturally reshapes itself to the user for the best fit.

When worn, it gives the user a single-minded focus and a +4 bonus to concentration checks. However, it prevents them from casting new concentration spells until the last one runs its course.

If the helmet is taken off while concentrating on a spell, the spell automatically fails without a concentration check.
A shield is made from wood or metal and is carried in one hand. Wielding a shield increases your Armor Class by 2. You can benefit from only one shield at a time.
